title: Eric Davis says the head of crash retrieval refused to talk

tellings.quote: Well, I would love to talk to the head of the crash retrieval program during that era, but he refused to talk to us.

plain: The man who ran a secret program to recover crashed unknown craft refused to be interviewed, says Eric W. Davis, a researcher who was looking into such programs. Speaking on Michels's show in August 2026, Davis says he "would love to talk to the head of the crash retrieval program during that era, but he refused to talk to us," and he names Glenn Gaffney in the discussion. He tells it because, if such a program existed, its leader would hold the answers.
